finder.title: A consultative shortlist in four questions
finder.q1hint: This shapes touch, tone and how much instrument you need.
finder.q2hint: Room size and acoustics guide the right size and type.
finder.q2bs: A room to fill, not overwhelm
finder.q2cs: Room for a grand to breathe
finder.q3: New, used, or open to both?
finder.q3hint: Used can offer remarkable value — when properly verified.
finder.q4hint: We'll weight your shortlist toward this priority.
finder.baseText: Based on your answers, here are the instruments that fit best. Choose one to continue — or go back to change your answers.
finder.chooseHint: Select one or more pianos to continue, or go back to adjust your answers.
finder.chosenThanks: . We'll tailor our advice around your shortlist. Book a no-obligation consultation and we'll compare them honestly for you.
finder.chosenCtaOne: Book a consultation about this piano
finder.chosenCtaMany: Book a consultation about your shortlist
finder.usedNote: We don't have verified used instruments listed yet — here are the closest new options. We can source and independently verify a used piano for you.
finder.noneNote: Here are the closest options — a short consultation will refine the shortlist.
finder.libEmpty: Book a consultation and we will build your shortlist personally.

finderResult.grand: A grand piano sized to the room
finderResult.grandOrTall: A tall upright or compact grand
finderResult.baseText: Based on your answers, here is a sensible starting point. A short consultation will refine it into a specific shortlist of makes and models.
finderResult.vintageAdd: A verified used instrument could offer excellent value here — we would inspect condition before you commit.
finderResult.selfAdd: We would also look at self-playing-capable models such as Feurich with integrated systems.
finderResult.valueAdd: We will weight the shortlist toward the best value for your budget, new or pre-owned.
finderResult.longevityAdd: We will favour makers with strong build quality and resale value.
